![](figures/figureS_alad_cohort/figureS_alad_cohort.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label alad-cohort >}}.
CCC-RISE factor evaluation in the ALAD cohort.** ({{< panel alad-cohort cohort >}}) Schematic of the ALAD cohort data\ [@doi:10.1016/j.healun.2024.02.007].
({{< panel alad-cohort cp-collinearity >}}) Largest absolute cosine between the condition, sender, receiver, and LR pair factors of any two CPD components across ranks, as the median (line and points) and IQR (band) over 10 seeded SVD starts per rank.
({{< panel alad-cohort factors genes >}}) RISE factor matrices representing component loadings of conditions and genes; each component normalized to its largest absolute loading.
({{< panel alad-cohort rise-fms >}}) RISE gene factor and ({{< panel alad-cohort cpd-fms >}}) CPD LR pair factor FMS of each component across leave-one-patient-out jackknife replicates (n = 45).
Each replicate's components were matched to the reported fit by Hungarian matching.
Boxes show the median and IQR and whiskers show the most extreme values within 1.5-times the IQR.
({{< panel alad-cohort permutation-fraction >}}) Fraction of each LR pair's (n = 570) condition by sender by receiver entries exceeding a null of within-sample cell permutations at p < 0.05 (one-sided empirical test).

![](figures/figureS_ibd_rank_selection/figureS_ibd_rank_selection.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label ibd-rank-selection >}}.
CCC-RISE rank selection and RISE factor matrices in the IBD cohort.** ({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cohort >}}) Schematic of the IBD cohort data\ [@doi:10.1038/s41588-026-02634-7].
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection rise-rank-selection >}}) RISE R^2^X across ranks of the fit on all data and, in BiCV, of the fit on the training block (BiCV train) and its prediction of the held-out block (BiCV test); mean ± SD over 10 repeats per rank.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection bicv-test >}}) BiCV test R^2^X from ({{< panel ibd-rank-selection rise-rank-selection >}}) on its own magnified axis.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cp-r2x-starts >}}) CPD fit R^2^X across ranks: the median (line) and range (band) over 10 seeded SVD starts per rank.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cp-collinearity >}}) Largest absolute cosine between the LR pair factors of any two CPD components across ranks, for each start (points), colored by whether the start reaches the solution most starts reach at its rank (blue) or another solution (grey).
Boxes show the median and IQR and whiskers show the most extreme values within 1.5-times the IQR.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cp-minima >}}) Number of the 10 starts reaching each distinct solution across ranks (starts joined at FMS ≥ 0.95): the solution most starts reach (blue, bottom) and each other solution (grey), colored as in ({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cp-collinearity >}}).
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection mode-collinearity >}}) Largest absolute cosine between the condition, sender, receiver, and LR pair factors of any two CPD components across ranks, as the median (line and points) and IQR (band) over the starts.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection factors genes >}}) RISE factor matrices at the selected rank representing component loadings of conditions and genes.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection eigenstate-heatmap >}}) RISE cell-type--eigen-state associations derived from RISE projection matrices: mean RISE projection of each cell type's cells onto each eigen-state.

![](figures/figureS_ibd_associations/figureS_ibd_associations.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label ibd-associations >}}.
Association of CPD components and covariates with IBD biopsy type.** ({{< panel ibd-associations cp-associations >}}) One-way ANOVA η^2^ of each CPD component's condition loadings against each IBD biopsy categorization.
\*: q < 0.05, Benjamini--Hochberg (BH) corrected across all categorizations and components.
({{< panel ibd-associations status-loadings >}}) CPD component ({{< panel ibd-associations status-loadings.1 >}}) 3 and ({{< panel ibd-associations status-loadings.2 >}}) 4 condition loadings by CD inflammation status.
Violins show the distribution of loadings, points show individual biopsies, and ticks mark the median.
One-way ANOVA F and η^2^, with p BH corrected across all categorizations and components.
({{< panel ibd-associations lineage-proportions >}}) Fraction of each biopsy's cells in each coarsely annotated cell type for healthy, CD uninflamed, and CD inflamed samples, on a square-root scale.
Boxes show the median and IQR and whiskers show the most extreme values within 1.5-times the IQR.
Values at the top of each cell type are Kruskal--Wallis q-values across the three groups, BH corrected across cell types.
({{< panel ibd-associations covariates >}}) One-way ANOVA η^2^ of each biopsy covariate and coarse cell-type fraction against each biopsy categorization, with binary covariates coded 0/1.
\*: p < 0.05, uncorrected.

![](figures/figureS_comparator_rank_selection/figureS_comparator_rank_selection.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label comparator-rank-selection >}}.
Rank selection of the label-based comparators.** Each method's own rank selection on coarse (top row) and fine (bottom row) labels, ALAD and IBD together; the bar under each row's panels names their method and labelling.
Dashed lines mark each cohort's chosen rank, alternating in both cohorts' colors where they chose the same rank, and red circles mark the Kneedle elbow.
PB, pseudobulk CPD; TC2C, Tensor-cell2cell; STAC, STACCato.
({{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-fit-coarse >}}, {{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-fit-fine >}}) PB fit R^2^X across ranks, over 10 seeded SVD starts per rank.
Lines show the median and bands the range over starts.
({{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-collinearity-coarse >}}, {{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-collinearity-fine >}}) Largest absolute cosine between the LR pair factors of any two PB components, over the same starts.
Median and range, as in ({{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-fit-coarse >}}, {{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-fit-fine >}}).
({{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-minima-coarse >}}, {{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-minima-fine >}}) Share of a rank's PB starts that reach its most common solution.
Starts are counted as one solution when their FMS is at least 0.95.
({{< panel comparator-rank-selection tc2c-elbow-coarse >}}, {{< panel comparator-rank-selection tc2c-elbow-fine >}}) TC2C normalized reconstruction error across ranks, over 10 random starts per rank.
Lines show the mean and bands the range.
({{< panel comparator-rank-selection stac-shares-coarse >}}, {{< panel comparator-rank-selection stac-shares-fine >}}) STAC eigenvalue share of each component of each mode's unfolding.
The dashed line marks the 1% cutoff.
Cores are given as condition × LR pair × sender × receiver.

![](figures/figureS_comparator_missed/figureS_comparator_missed.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label comparator-missed >}}.
Comparator LR columns that are not part of a CCC-RISE component.** PB, pseudobulk CPD; STAC, STACCato; C and F, coarse and fine labels.
LR columns are named by method (P, S) and number, and top LR pairs are as in {{< fig 5 >}}.
({{< panel comparator-missed alad-share ibd-share >}}) Share of each PB and STAC LR column's squared LR pair loading that falls on the top LR pairs of one CCC-RISE component, in ALAD ({{< panel comparator-missed alad-share >}}; n = 40 columns) and IBD ({{< panel comparator-missed ibd-share >}}; n = 27).
Each fit starts at the same height in both cohorts.
Sixteen ALAD and fourteen IBD columns fall below 0.5.
({{< panel comparator-missed alad-contents ibd-contents >}}) Top LR pairs of the columns below 0.5 that have an association at q < 0.05, as in {{< fig 5 labels-alad labels-ibd >}}, and carry a top LR pair outside every CCC-RISE component's top LR pairs whose ligand and receptor are different genes, in ALAD ({{< panel comparator-missed alad-contents >}}) and IBD ({{< panel comparator-missed ibd-contents >}}).
Points are sized by absolute loading relative to the column's largest.
The CCC-RISE column shows each LR pair's largest such value in any CCC-RISE component.

![](figures/figureS_comparator_single_cell/figureS_comparator_single_cell.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label comparator-single-cell >}}.
Single-cell comparison of CCC-RISE populations.** ({{< panel comparator-single-cell alad-weights >}}) ALAD and ({{< panel comparator-single-cell ibd-weights >}}) IBD per-cell sender weight against receiver weight on each CCC-RISE component, each relative to its largest value (ALAD, n = 51,273 cells; IBD, n = 634,534 cells).
Dashed lines mark the 0.3 cutoff (τ) that defines each component's sender, receiver and both populations.
({{< panel comparator-single-cell alad-tau >}}) ALAD and ({{< panel comparator-single-cell ibd-tau >}}) IBD fraction of NICHES+ cells in each sender (solid) and receiver (dotted) population, minus the fraction predicted by cell type as in {{< fig 5 niches-fraction >}}, across cutoffs τ from 0.1 to 0.6.
A population is drawn only while it has at least 10 cells.
The grey line marks the 0.3 cutoff used throughout, and the dashed line marks no difference.
({{< panel comparator-single-cell scriabin-seeds >}}) Agreement between random seeds in ALAD, measured as the mean best-match Jaccard index between two seeds' LR sets.
Scriabin's LR sets are its interaction programs that pass its significance test, whereas CCC-RISE's are its components' top LR pairs.
Each point is a pair of seeds, and bars mark medians.
Both Scriabin and CCC-RISE used 10 seed refits (n = 45 pairs each).

{{< xlsx figures/tables/alad_outcome_groups.xlsx >}}

**{{< label alad-outcome-groups >}}.
ALAD samples by outcome group.** Number of BAL samples in each ALAD cohort outcome group.
Shown are label groupings (ALAD status and six-month outcome), high-level patient labels, and subgroup labels.
Two of the 45 patients were sampled twice, in different groups.
